proof_scope: the runner's own gates exercised through run.sh against crafted manifests, plus a real report-artifact readback; dogfoods claim-based readiness (#1445), the real-E2E contract (#1446), and seam coverage (#1448)

claims.proves: agentic-evals holds its own fail-closed, teardown, claim-separation, evidence-qualification, and report-emission capabilities to the same evidence contract it enforces on other skills
claims.does_not_prove: the browser/persistence incidents backfilled as gaps in other skills, which require live provider/session boundaries

what_was_exercised: run.sh invoked against fault-injected manifests and one passing manifest whose emitted report is read back as an artifact
what_remains_unverified: cross-skill live browser and persistence capabilities (tracked as UNMAPPED incidents in fixtures/regressions.json)

capability_claims.description: run exits non-zero unless every required case is READY, and --report-only opts out
a timed-out case terminates its process group and leaves no orphan
passing deterministic cases cannot satisfy a required live_e2e slot (#1445)
a live_e2e case with no independent readback is downgraded and cannot satisfy a live slot (#1446)
run emits a machine-readable report whose readiness field an independent reader can verify
categorize assigns a complete failure set to stable category_ids
the active category DAG renders + validates through the live phart-dag-chart skill
remediate builds a topo-ordered depends-on ticket plan in preview without mutating
a cyclic category map is rejected by the acyclicity gate before any ticket mutation
an unclassified failure hard-errors rather than silently escaping the loop

cases.name: gate-fails-closed-on-failed-required-case
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; D=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"f","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","exit 3"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/f.json"; $R run "$D/f.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0 && $R run "$D/f.json" --report-only >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo GATE_OK
